subject: Conversation transcript retention carveout & keystore residency evidence
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@nuvohealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: NuvoHealth Security <security@nuvohealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-03T15:12:00Z
Subject: Retention carveout for conversational transcripts + keystore residency evidence

Hi Kimberly,

Quick one from our security & compliance team — hope you can help. We are assessing the transcript retention policy for conversational features we plan to launch with Redwood. A couple of asks: 

- Can Redwood provide evidence that conversational transcripts (API request/response text) can be scoped and retained for 90 days for a single tenant (NuvoHealth) rather than your standard 30-day ephemeral policy? We need a short description of the controls and a proposed process for a tenant-specific carveout.
- For audit purposes we also need proof that the keystore used to encrypt PII-derived artifacts for NuvoHealth can be constrained to EU residency (KMS metadata + export snapshot) or, if not, a clear statement of where keys are located and what compensating controls exist.

Deliverables we need to move forward with our internal reviewers: a brief summary of the retention carveout workflow, a redacted keystore residency summary (metadata only), and a sample export showing a transcript record (redacted) with retention flags. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide those and an estimated delivery date?

Appreciate it — Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of Security Operations | NuvoHealth
From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@nuvohealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-03T16:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Retention carveout for conversational transcripts + keystore residency evidence

Elaine — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: yes, we can support a tenant-scoped retention carveout and provide redacted residency evidence; below is the proposed plan and what we'll deliver.

Proposed carveout workflow (high level):
1) Signed amendment / acceptance: customer approves a short data-retention addendum that specifies 90-day transcript retention for the NuvoHealth tenant.
2) Config change & guardrails: ops enables a tenant-level retention TTL override in our control plane; records labeled as "conversation_transcript" for that tenant will carry a 90d retention flag. Overrides are audited and require secondary approval from our security reviewer.
3) Access & audit: transcripts are accessible to NuvoHealth via the export API for the retention window; access logs are retained and included in the evidence packet.
4) Deletion automation: after 90 days records are queued for irreversible deletion; deletion runbooks produce a manifest (hash proof) we provide on request.

Keystore residency evidence we can supply: 
- Redacted KMS metadata snapshot (region tags, key alias, creation/rotation timestamps) — will not include raw key material.
- HSM tenancy description and export logs showing which region the key material is provisioned.
- Compensating controls: cross-region replication policy, HSM access logs, and customer-specific access restrictions (if we must keep keys outside EU).

Deliverables and ETA:
- redacted-keystore-residency-summary.pdf (metadata + controls): 3 business days
- transcript-retention-sample-extract.csv (single redacted record with retention flags and access-log stub): 2 business days
- short carveout addendum template & runbook excerpt: 2 business days

I'll coordinate with Neha to prepare the SOC/SIG artifacts (redacted evidence links) and with Markus for the deletion manifest format. If NuvoHealth requires keys physically resident in the EU, we'll confirm the feasible options and any lead time for a dedicated KMS configuration.

Next steps: please confirm that providing redacted metadata is sufficient for your reviewers, and whether NuvoHealth requires an in-person evidence review or if the Drive packet + attestations will do.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Director, Product Compliance | Redwood Inference
[redwood.ai]
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@nuvohealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: NuvoHealth Security <security@nuvohealth.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-03T18:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Retention carveout for conversational transcripts + keystore residency evidence

Kimberly — perfect, that approach should work for our auditors. A couple clarifications:

- Redacted metadata is fine; auditors want to see region tags and rotation cadence plus proof of the key alias mapping to our tenant.
- For the deletion manifest, can you include a short description of the irreversible deletion process (sweeps + manifest hash) and an example manifest for one record?
- We prefer the evidence packet on Drive with a DocuSign attestation from Redwood's security lead. If an in-person review is necessary later, we'll escalate.

If you can push the two CSV/PDF artifacts by Friday EOD (NuvoHealth timezone) we'll begin our review. Thanks — Elaine
